title: Weighted approximate tangent spaces survive restriction to a Borel set almost everywhere (Simon Ch. 1, 3.6; Ch. 3, 1.7)
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ and Hᵏ := μHE[k] on ℝ^N. Let M ⊆ ℝ^N be Hᵏ-null-measurable and θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with θ(x) > 0 for x ∈ M and θ Hᵏ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N. Let A ⊆ ℝ^N be a Borel set. Then for Hᵏ⌞(M ∩ A)-almost every x, every linear subspace L of ℝ^N which is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x L, Simon Ch. 3, 1.7) is also a weighted approximate tangent space of (M ∩ A, θ) at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl N), MeasurableSet A → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict (M ∩ A)), ∀ L : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x L → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k (M ∩ A) θ x L
